Según el medio de comunicación 'Axios', el príncipe heredero de Arabia Saudita ha hecho pedidos a Estados Unidos de que ataque a los aliados de Irán, pero Donald Trump se habría negado. item.title: Ofensiva hutí reconfigura el equilibrio en Yemen: así se eleva el riesgo de un doble bloqueo comercial
item.description: Según han confirmado diversas fuentes militares, los rebeldes respaldados por Irán alcanzaron la estratégica isla de Perim, también conocida como Mayun, situada en el estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb, y avanzan hacia Dhubab, la ciudad portuaria ubicada justo enfrente. Ante la inquietud internacional de que se produzca el bloqueo del tráfico marítimo en la zona, los hutíes afirman que la navegación sigue siendo "segura". Los combates han provocado la huida masiva de residentes y alimentan el miedo a otro frente de guerra. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: En directo: los hutíes de Yemen toman la isla de Perim, estratégica para el transporte de petróleo
item.description: Los rebeldes hutíes de Yemen, respaldados por Irán, capturaron este viernes 11 de septiembre la isla de Perim, estratégica en la entrada sur del mar Rojo, según informaron dos funcionarios. Esta acción abre un nuevo frente en la guerra de EE. UU. contra Irán y amenaza aún más las exportaciones de petróleo saudita a través de una de las rutas marítimas más importantes del mundo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: REPLAY: Hegseth warns of 'Islamist threat' at 9/11 25th anniversary commemorations
item.description: US defense secretary Pete Hegseth delivered remarks at a ceremony at the Pentagon on Friday on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. Hegseth used his speech to turn to the ongoing conflict in Iran and sought to connect it to the 2001 attacks on America. ““Our warriors have fought an Islamic theocracy that has wished us death for nearly half a century, that cheered on 9/11, a regime that has sponsored terrorist attacks against Americans for decades, killing thousands, including our comrades in Iraq, in Afghanistan," he said. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Instead of managing billions, Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett chose farming
item.description: Choosing a path less traveled, Howard Buffett, the son of Warren Buffett, dedicated his life to farming and conservation rather than finance. He skillfully managed farms in Nebraska and Illinois, prioritizing soil health. Warren Buffett supported his passion by purchasing a Nebraska farm for his son. As he transitions to the role of non-executive chairman at Berkshire Hathaway, Howard aims to safeguard the company’s culture following his father's legacy. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: US court rules 150,000 Mississippi residents have no constitutional right to lead-free water
item.description: A federal appeals court has determined that the US Constitution does not explicitly provide a right to clean drinking water. Residents of Jackson residents claimed their city was aware of unsafe water conditions but chose to mislead them. Although the court acknowledged the severity of these claims, it denied the establishment of a constitutional right to safe water and pointed to different legal recourses. Publicado también por: Mongabay. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: After husband’s death, she ensured their 215 acres stay protected
item.description: Becky Shelton made a conscious decision to prioritize land preservation over lucrative offers from developers. By securing her properties in King George and Stafford with legal protections, she ensures these areas remain untouched for future custodians. Shelton views her role as a temporary steward of the earth, taking action to prevent the encroachment of subdivisions and data centers on the natural landscape. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
